decision: Do not add another ADG holdout/model run in this work block: the existing CPER-to-CGREC transport report already provides a reproducible external-site evaluation, a simple development-set mean baseline, prediction errors, bias, and explicit limits. Preserve the DMI target gate as NO-GO.

source.population: Yearling steers at the Central Grasslands Research Extension Center, North Dakota

development.site: USDA-ARS Central Plains Experimental Range, Colorado

existingEvaluation.target: Raw endpoint ADG derived as (final weight - initial weight) / ADG_DAYS, converted from lb/day to kg/day

separation.adultMatureCowPastureDmi: not evaluated; no eligible observed DMI source

limitations: This is an ADG-only component transport diagnostic across two sites, not a supervised ML benchmark and not validation of the DMI equation or full engine.
CGREC holdout is one site with steer records from only 1989, 1994, and 2015; the 2015 subset is 200 of 291 records.

The frozen engine uses observed starting weight and duration but illustrative default pasture configuration; observed biomass, weather, forage quality, stocking group, and supplementation are not aligned as model inputs.
CGREC outcomes are not used to fit or select the CPER scale or development-mean baseline.
Reported row-level metrics are not a calibrated prediction interval and do not quantify full uncertainty or transport to Brazil.
